name: UnSub (ARTEX multi-model operator, 19-market targeting) — Zscaler ThreatLabz
description: ThreatLabz recovered a Chinese-speaking operator's customized ARTEX deployment (planner/worker AI pentest framework extended with nmap, sqlmap, nuclei, httpx, jadx, apktool and frida) driven through Claude Code, Codex and Grok workspaces with multi-model routing, context-injection hooks and sync scripts. Prompt histories targeted dating, SMS, crypto/payment, gift-card, gambling, retail, education, logistics, investment and legal-claims sites referencing 19 countries; the operator used proxy chains and archived data to Backblaze B2. *Analyst note: Zscaler gives no victim count or confirmed compromises (the 19 countries come from prompts), model identities are unverified, and overlap with the CrowdStrike South Korea row is not established; Zscaler's earlier 14 Oct post on South Korean targeting is related. TTP IDs are analyst-mapped (Zscaler cites only MITRE ATLAS). Vendor source.* Zscaler ThreatLabz
